description: Compares a reference photo with 1 to 8 Rabbit products, image by image, with Rabbit’s judges: for each one “same”, “close” (same kind, another model), “different” or “not judged”, with a short reason. Call it to check that a result is the same product as their photo.

derniere_photo.description: true: the reference photo is the last one they sent to Rabbit (the send_a_photo link, the app or the Chrome extension).

produits.description: The `produit` references to compare (1 to 8, they start with “p”).

url_photo.description: The public https address of the reference photo.

name: same_product
title: Same product?
